library(dplyr)
# This will read ALL .tsv files in your current working directory
file_list <- list.files(pattern = "\\.tsv$")
# Check which files were found
print(file_list)
# Read and process all files
final_df <- lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
}) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean)) %>%
  ungroup()
final_df <- as.data.frame(final_df)
dim(final_df)
write.csv(final_df,"merged_bacteria.csv",row.names=F)
